verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss's own pricing page claims email sync ('Sync your calendar & email') and sending email from inside the CRM. That is a first-party email-sync capability, but it is documented only as a one-line marketing bullet. missing for 10: named Gmail and Outlook connection support, evidence that sync is two-way, automatic logging of emails to the correct contact records, in-depth setup docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect Gmail or Outlook so emails sync two-way and log automatically to the right records

citations.quote: Call, text and email directly from FUB
